headword: {真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ}

definitions.gloss: head-on contest; direct confrontation; fair and square fight
definitions.explanation: A straightforward, direct contest without tricks, evasion, or indirect tactics. Implies facing a challenge or opponent head-on with full force and sincerity.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧。
examples.english: To challenge someone to a head-on contest.

examples.japanese: {小細工|こざいく}なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}ちたい→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: I want to win in a fair, head-on fight without tricks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦ピッチャー→ピッチャー：09482_picchaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強打者|きょうだしゃ}→強打者：23977_kyoudasha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挑|いど}み→挑む：12708_idomu⟧、⟦{三振|さんしん}→三振：08588_sanshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{取|と}った→打ち取る：30008_uchitoru⟧。
examples.english: The young pitcher challenged the slugger head-on and struck him out.

notes:
Composed of {真|ま}っ{向|こう} (head-on, directly facing) and ⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧ (contest, match). Often used in sports, especially baseball, where a pitcher throws strikes directly rather than using balls to walk a dangerous batter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧ (to challenge to a head-on fight)
- {真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧ (to fight head-on)
- ⟦{正々堂々|せいせいどうどう}→正々堂々：25225_seiseidoudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ} (fair and square head-on contest)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ}: head-on, straightforward contest
- {直接対決|ちょくせつたいけつ}: direct confrontation (neutral, factual)
- ⟦{一騎打|いっきう}ち→一騎打ち：11186_ikkiuchi⟧: one-on-one duel (emphasis on the matchup)
